## Proof

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] ARM build without warnings and `tests/run_qemu.py` pass (if `core/`, `platform/`, `hmiapp/` or `tools/` changed)
- [ ] Installation procedure rehearsed with the car's BusyBox (if `docs/INSTALLATION.md` or the release layout changed)
- [ ] **Tried in a car**: which car, iDrive software, what was checked. Otherwise say "PC only".

## Safety

- [ ] No BMW file, car log, VIN, password or personal data added
- [ ] Nothing new is written to the car or sent on its network; or it is described above and in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Non publié"
